## Analysis

`sol_0008` directly tested the proposed dense-core/sparse-fringe family and again returned the unchanged parent. Together with `sol_0006`–`0007`, this refutes both boundary flexibility and one-dimensional periodic structure as likely routes past 1.111815. The common limitation is the carry-heavy embedding of row masks into a short integer interval, which collapses distinct coordinate sums and differences. A carry-free multidimensional embedding offers a genuinely different search space while retaining exact, fast scoring and the 512-element budget.
